WEEKLY FEEDBACK REPORT  |  28 Sep to 4 Oct 2026
Total reviews: 230   Positive 33%   Neutral 8%   Negative 59%

TOP 3 COMPLAINTS
  1. Late delivery ............ 52 reviews  (mostly Swiggy and Amazon; evenings and Friday nights; English, Tamil, and Tanglish)
  2. Unexpected or hidden charges  21 reviews  (spread across Swiggy, Amazon, Google, and Zomato; mostly English, Tamil, and Tanglish)
  3. Wrong or missing order items  18 reviews  (mostly Swiggy and Amazon; high-urgency refund cases; English, Tamil, and Tanglish)

TOP PRAISE
  Tasty biryani and well-spiced food (38 mentions), Neat, leak-proof packaging (20 mentions), Friendly and courteous staff (9 mentions)

URGENT: 41 reviews need a reply within 24 hours

ACTION ITEMS
  1. Escalate delivery operations for evening and Friday-night orders: tighten rider assignment, dispatch timing, and live delay monitoring on Swiggy and Amazon-heavy slots.
  2. Audit item accuracy and refund handling: add a pre-dispatch checklist for veg/non-veg separation, missing items, and faster support follow-up for misdeliveries.
  3. Rework pricing transparency at menu and checkout: remove surprise packing/service charges, display final bill clearly before payment, and brief stores on consistent billing.
